title: Formulas for Koornwinder polynomials
summary: This paper provides formulas for Koornwinder polynomials in analogy with the creation formula, the alcove walk formula and the non-attacking fillings formula for the type $GL_n$ Macdonald polynomials. We state the creation formula in terms of the divided-difference operators used in Schubert calculus, and we use a box-greedy reduced word to reformulate the alcove walk formula in terms of uncompressed set-valued tableaux.
